components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #ff2a2a; color: #000; padding: 1rem 2rem; font-family: 'Syne', sans-serif; font-size: 1.2rem; font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; border: 3px solid #000; box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 #f0f0f0; transition: all 0.1s cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translate(2px, 2px); box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 #f0f0f0; }

components.name: Brutal Card
components.css: .ds-brutal-card { background: #000; border: 4px solid #f0f0f0; box-shadow: 8px 8px 0 #ff007f; padding: 2.5rem; transition: transform 0.1s cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1), box-shadow 0.1s cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1); color: #f0f0f0; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; } .ds-brutal-card:hover { transform: translate(4px, 4px); box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 #ff007f; } .ds-brutal-card h3 { font-family: 'Syne', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 2rem; margin-bottom: 1rem; margin-top: 0; }

components.name: Badge
components.css: .ds-max-badge { display: inline-block; padding: 0.3rem 0.8rem; background: #eaff00; color: #000; font-family: 'Syne', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; border: 2px solid #000; box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 #000; font-size: 0.85rem; }

narrative.overview: The visual language is raw, glitchy, comic-book inspired, and undeniably fun. It completely rejects modern, minimalist "clean" design in favor of aggressive, high-contrast, hyper-pop energy. The aesthetic is built on harsh collisions of saturated neon colors against deep blacks, paired with brutalist typography and hard offset drop shadows.
keyCharacteristics: Strictly flat geometry with zero blur or softness

rules.name: The Maximum Contrast Rule
rules.body: Neons must only ever touch deep blacks or pure whites. Never mix neons together in gradients; they must collide with hard edges.

rules.name: The Glitch Rule
rules.body: Important display text should break the fourth wall using the custom CSS glitch animation with split cyan and pink channels.

rules.name: The Hard Offset Rule
rules.body: All shadows must be solid blocks of color with 0px blur.

dos: Do use heavy, solid-color offset shadows for any elevated element.
Do ensure all borders are at least 3px thick.
Do keep components completely rectangular (no rounded corners).
donts: Don't use soft box-shadows or blurs (except for the underlying hero ambient blobs).
Don't use pastel or muted colors.
Don't use subtle transitions; interactions should feel instantaneous or bouncy.
